thought.text: XPlanCLI works ("xPlanBox 9.4-SNAPSHOT"). Let me smoke-test the XPlanValidatorExecutor standalone app (guide: `java -jar xplan-validator-executor.jar`):

reasoning_content:
Excellent! XPlanCLI works: `xpb version` → "xPlanBox 9.4-SNAPSHOT".

Remaining items:
1. XPlanValidatorExecutor — the guide describes how to run it (java -jar xplan-validator-executor.jar). Let's do a quick smoke test with the environment variables (it connects to RabbitMQ, S3, DB). Start it up briefly and check whether it starts up normally.
2. Documentation zip — it exists in the distribution.
3. The index.html of xPlanRessourcen references localhost:8080 — since Apache is listening on 8080, this is already correct.

Let's quickly test the validator executor:

action.command:
source /etc/xplanbox.env
cd /opt/xplanbox
nohup java -jar xplan-validator-executor.jar > /tmp/executor.log 2>&1 &
echo "executor PID $!"
sleep 45
grep -E "Started|started|ERROR|Exception|Tomcat started|port" /tmp/executor.log | head -10
echo "=== monitor port 8080? (guide: connects to 8080 for monitoring; change with --server.port) ==="
grep -oE "port [0-9]+|Tomcat started on port [0-9]+" /tmp/executor.log | head -3
